in_marathi.name: Souhvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine Gift, Graceful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Souhvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Souhvansh is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Sou’ meaning divine and ‘Hans’ meaning gift or grace. It symbolizes the divine gift bestowed upon a child. This name is often given to signify the child’s birth as a blessing from the gods.
